frase_gancho.texto: Cities of kings and scribes who measured time with hieroglyphs.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: The Maya never formed a single empire. They were independent cities, each with its own ruler, that formed alliances, traded, and also waged war on one another. They wrote their history in hieroglyphs and calculated the cycles of the Sun, the Moon, and Venus. In this hall you will find the mask and the head of Pakal, the re-creation of his crypt, and the panel of the Cross of Palenque. You will also see the lintel from Yaxchilán, the stela from Calakmul, and the figurines from Jaina. There are also pieces from Chichén Itzá, where the Maya tradition blended with influences from central Mexico.
